Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 9  
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer failed to correctly identify the death year of John Cromwell, leading to an incorrect comparison. The step where the WebSurfer provided the Planner with the death year of John Cromwell as 1979 is the most responsible mistake. This error directly led to the incorrect conclusion that John Cromwell died later than Alfred Rolfe.
